newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FUENTES TO MISS CHILE'S MATCH WITH PERU.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FUENTES TO MISS CHILE'S MATCH WITH PERU.

text.p: Ronaldo Fuentes will miss Chile's World Cup qualifier against Peru next Sunday after receiving a one-match suspension from the International Football Federation (FIFA) for a second booking in the competition on Monday.

Fuentes collected his second caution of the current qualifying series in Chile's game against Argentina on December 15 but FIFA was not immediately notified because of a clerical error by the match referee.
The booking was later verified and Fuentes has been suspended for Chile's next match against Peru in Lima.
